name: bms-analyzer
description: BMS to ordinal analyzer — Rust/WASM core with Vite + TypeScript

scripts.build:wasm: cd src/rust && cargo build -p bms-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && WB="$(command -v wasm-bindgen || echo /root/.cargo/bin/wasm-bindgen)" && "$WB" target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/bms_wasm.wasm --out-dir ../wasm/pkg --target web --no-typescript
scripts.build:cli: cargo build --release -p analyzer-cli --manifest-path src/rust/Cargo.toml && cp src/rust/target/release/analyzer-cli .
